title: MZ [Cynthia Tools]Fix for Troop Battle Events Triggering in Wrong Troops (Free Plugin)

posts.author: CynthiaTools
posts.body:
While working on system-heavy battle plugins, I ran into an undocumented issue in RPG Maker MZ where troop battle events are not strictly bound to their troop ID.
As a result, event pages defined in one troop can activate in other troops when conditions match (Turn / HP / Span), which can silently break boss logic and advanced battle systems.
I’ve released
CT_TroopEventIsolation
, a free plugin that fixes this by enforcing troop ID isolation during event page evaluation.
• No setup or parameters
• Safe for existing projects
• Engine-level fix (not an interpreter workaround)
Download and details here:
[itch.io link]
Hope this helps others avoid some serious head-scratching.

Thanks for the clarification.
To clarify, this plugin does not target plugin-defined behavior.
It addresses an
undocumented engine behavior
where troop event page
selection does not verify troop identity.
Some plugins intentionally rely on this side effect (often using Troop ID 1
as a global hook), which is valid
within those plugins
if documented.
However, in vanilla RPG Maker MZ, troop events are not documented as global,
and this behavior can silently break advanced battle logic when not intended.
CT_TroopEventIsolation is designed for developers who want strict troop
isolation and predictable behavior. It is optional and may not be suitable
for projects that intentionally rely on global troop events.

Good question, and yes — this can be reproduced
without any plugins
.
The reason it’s rarely noticed is because it only becomes visible when multiple troops share similar battle event conditions.
Minimal reproduction steps (vanilla MZ):
Create
Troop 0001
Add a Battle Event
Condition:
Turn 1
Span:
Battle
Command: Show Battle Message (“Troop 1 event”)
Create
Troop 0002
No battle events at all
Start a battle against
Troop 0002
Observed behavior:
The battle event from
Troop 0001
can trigger during Troop 0002’s battle when the turn condition matches.
Expected behavior (based on documentation / editor UI):
Battle events defined in a troop should only apply to that troop.
What’s happening internally is that troop event page selection does not verify the active troop ID before evaluating page conditions. Some plugins intentionally rely on this side effect (often using Troop ID 1 as a global hook), but this behavior is not documented as a vanilla engine feature.
The plugin I shared simply enforces strict troop isolation for developers who want predictable, troop-scoped behavior. It’s optional and may not be suitable for projects that intentionally rely on global troop events.

returns the array of events
read directly from the database entry

and most likely that was not a bug, but a misconfigured feature.
It's called "base troop event" and is implemented by battle plugins from several programmers (see "feature")
basically you designate one troop as the base troop that will NEVER be used in the game.
And the plugin runs all troop events from that base troop in EVERY battle.
The intention is to have a place where you put those troop events that you will need in every battle (for skills or whatever), meaning they are only once in the engine and you have only one place to edit despite needing copies in every battle.
and your problem sounds as if you have a regular troop with the ID of the base troop without knowing it, but you can change the ID for the base troop (or disable it) in the plugin options.
